Messages.Author: William_Feitosa
Messages.Body:
I have a question regarding apparition. Can i use apparition to prevent additional strikes?

Example - My vampire with [CHI] has only one blood and the oposing minion declares his atack to be a hand strike for 1 damage i declare the same and use apparition to prevent the strike. At the additional strikes phase my oponnent uses superior Pursuit to get one additional strike and declares his strike to be a hand strike for 1 damage.

My question is, can i use apparition to prevent my oponnents additional strike damage since i only used it to prevent 1 damage?

Apparition-
Combat
[chi] This vampire can prevent 1 damage each round this combat
[CHI] This Vampire can prevent 2 damage each round this combat

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> William_Feitosa wrote:
> I have a question regarding apparition. Can i use apparition to prevent additional strikes?
>
Yes.

> William_Feitosa wrote:
> Example - My vampire with [CHI] has only one blood and the oposing minion declares his atack to be a hand strike for 1 damage i declare the same and use apparition to prevent the strike. At the additional strikes phase my oponnent uses superior Pursuit to get one additional strike and declares his strike to be a hand strike for 1 damage.
>
> My question is, can i use apparition to prevent my oponnents additional strike damage since i only used it to prevent 1 damage?
>
Yes. Each Apparition at superior prevents a total of 2 damage during the same round. Those damage can be inflicted and prevented separately.
